source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Determine the cause of injury or illness.
3. Reference OSHA's General Recording Criteria.
4. Identify OSHA recording exemptions.
5. Determine if the injury or illness is work-related.
6. Note if the event is not work-related. (Code 3 on OSHALog)
7. If a medical condition is aggravated while away from work, the time away must be recorded. Note this on OSHAlog.
8. If the event is work-related, compare with the list of OSHA exempt injuries and illnesses.
9. Note OSHA exemption details on OSHAlog.
10. If OSHA exempt, move on to the next record.
11. If event is work-related and is not exempt, evaluate the injury or illness description against the criteria in OSHA 300.
12. If the event involves more than one body part, document the most severe.
13
